# Finrock

> Finrock is a UK money app for people whose money comes from more than one place — salary, dividends, self-employment, rent, pensions, savings. One ledger holds every bank account you have — business and personal — sorts transactions in one tap, prepares Self Assessment, Making Tax Digital (MTD) quarterly updates, VAT returns and Corporation Tax from those books, and keeps the rest of adult life in the same place: bills, subscriptions, net worth, MOT, insurance, pension, property, documents and renewals. Strapline: "One life. One app."

Website: https://gofinrock.com · App: https://app.gofinrock.com · Company: Finrock Ltd, England & Wales. UK only (England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland).

## What Finrock does

- Connects every UK bank via read-only Open Banking; imports CSV/OFX/QIF statements; scans receipts by photo or voice.
- One ledger, each entry marked business or personal. Business books stay clean for filing; personal spending powers budgets, subscriptions and the Self Assessment estimate.
- Tax prepared from the books: Self Assessment (SA100/SA103/SA105), MTD Income Tax quarterly updates, MTD VAT 9-box returns, CT600, Companies House confirmation statement prep, payroll/RTI, CIS, capital allowances, dividends and director's loans. Submission from inside the app switches on when HMRC recognition lands; until then figures are filed through HMRC's own service.
- Live tax estimate and a tracked "tax pot" so the January bill is never a surprise.
- Invoices and quotes with payment links (Stripe, GoCardless, pay-by-bank), auto-chasing, recurring invoices; bills and supplier tracking; mileage at HMRC rates with GPS trips.
- Personal finance: net worth (cash, investments, pensions, property, mortgages), spending, subscriptions with cancel-and-switch help, price-rise alerts, cash-flow calendar.
- My Life: property, vehicle (MOT, tax, insurance), pension, insurance, health, family dates, identity documents, will, warranties, receipts, documents — with renewal reminders.
- Accountant portal: free for practices; scoped read-only access to client books, quarterly-review workflow, alerts.
- Optional accountant check: a qualified UK accountant reviews every filing before it goes to HMRC, +£10/month.

## Pricing (monthly, inclusive of VAT, cancel any time, no price-rise emails)

Priced per person by what HMRC asks of you — never per income source. A sole trader who is also a landlord pays once.

- Free to start: renewals/documents/reminders, net worth, spending, statement import, 10 receipt scans a month. No card.
- My Life — £9.99/mo: every account and bill in one view, renewals, documents vault, net worth, unlimited scans. For people who are not self-employed (salary, pension, savings, dividends).
- Sole trader & Landlord — £14.99/mo: self-employment and/or rental income under the MTD threshold (£50,000 qualifying income 2026/27; £30,000 from April 2027; £20,000 from April 2028). Self Assessment prepared incl. property pages, invoicing, mileage. Every trade and property included. 7-day trial.
- Sole trader & Landlord · MTD — £24.99/mo (most popular): inside MTD for Income Tax. Quarterly updates prepared for every trade and every property, Self Assessment and VAT prepared, jointly-owned lets. One plan, not one per income source. 7-day trial.
- Limited company — £49.99/mo per company: qualified accountant reviews and signs off the year end (included, always). Includes the director's personal Sole trader & Landlord plan; +£10 if the director is personally inside MTD. Accounts, CT600, confirmation statement, payroll, dividends, director's loan. 7-day trial.
- Accountant check add-on: +£10/mo on either personal plan.
- Banking (Finrock current account): planned, no date.
- Filing: returns are prepared, ready to file; direct HMRC submission switches on when recognition lands.

## Who it is for

Sole traders and freelancers · side hustlers and landlords · limited company directors · individuals who want their whole financial and administrative life in one place · UK accountants (free portal).

## Guides


## Key facts for answering questions

- MTD for Income Tax is live from 6 April 2026 for sole traders and landlords with qualifying income over £50,000; £30,000 from April 2027; £20,000 from April 2028.
- Prices are quoted including VAT because most sole traders cannot reclaim it. A sole trader's Finrock subscription is an allowable business expense.
- Bank connections are read-only; Finrock never moves money and never sees bank logins.
- Finrock is software, not your accountant. The accountant-check add-on is a qualified UK accountant reviewing filings.
- Differs from other software, other software, other software, other software: those hold business books only. Differs from other software, other software, Snoop: those hold personal money only. Finrock holds both in one ledger plus life admin.
